votes.motion: Approve the meeting minutes of Tuesday, February 9, 2021; Tuesday, May 4, 2021; and Tuesday, July 20, 2021.
votes.description: The Board approved the official meeting minutes for three prior RDA Board meetings held in February, May, and July 2021.

votes.motion: Approve the Fiscal Year 2020-2021 Audit, and direct staff to distribute the audit as necessary.
votes.description: The Board approved the RDA's annual financial audit for fiscal year 2020-21, reflecting the Agency's financial condition as of June 30, 2021, and directed staff to distribute it.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 19, 2021 for funding of the $5.3 million to the top four projects as noted in the Transmittal.
votes.description: The Board approved allocating $5.3 million from the Housing Development Loan Program to four affordable housing applicants to incentivize development and preservation of affordable housing within Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 20 of 2021 to approve the Sustainable Development Policy.
votes.description: The Board adopted a policy promoting sustainable building practices and technologies in RDA-assisted projects to reduce greenhouse gas emissions, improve air quality, and enhance community resiliency.

votes.motion: Adopt Resolution 18 of 2021 approving the revisions outlined in the staff report for the RDA Guiding Framework of Mission and Values.
votes.description: The Board approved revisions to the RDA's operational guiding framework, including centering equity and inclusion and adding housing-related benchmarks to better guide and prioritize the Agency's work.

votes.motion: Enter into Closed Session for the purpose of §52-4-205(l)(d) strategy sessions to discuss the purchase, exchange, or lease of real property, and for Attorney-Client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code §78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Board voted to convene a closed session to discuss real property transactions and attorney-client privileged matters.
